posts.zh:
dsh-omni-vision 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为纯文本模型装上本地眼睛：eyes_render 在 Web 界面画布上绘制文字/图形/Mermaid，eyes_paste 接收用户粘贴的图片，eyes_ocr 用 Windows 自带 OCR 离线读文字，eyes_analyze 把像素解析成结构化数据，全程无需视觉模型。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-40f70bdaa65c0e0d7c54.html
posts.en:
dsh-omni-vision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Local eyes for text-only models: eyes_render draws text/shapes/Mermaid onto a canvas in the Web GUI, eyes_paste captures pasted images, eyes_ocr reads text via the built-in Windows OCR (offline), and eyes_analyze inspects pixels as structured data — no vision model required.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-40f70bdaa65c0e0d7c54.html
